This directly addresses broad historical associations outranking current needs and can use interaction sequences and timestamps without requiring unobserved user traits.

searches.reason: Challenge the assumption that embedding similarity alone identifies useful next purchases. Seek lightweight models that distinguish directional transitions and complementary purchases from substitutes, using training histories and permitted titles/descriptions with text representations trained locally and no pretrained weights.
